TCS inaugurates India's first lights-out factory lab in Pune

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has launched India's first lights-out factory laboratory in Pune. This facility is designed to be fully automated and will power AI-led manufacturing processes. The lab aims to advance capabilities in areas such as artificial intelligence and machine learning for industrial applications.
